title: 阪神JFの後に・輝かしき一歩

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With an astounding show of talent, Air Groove wins the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she states that it's merely a waypoint on her journey to reach her ideal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove wishes to become a shining beacon that all Umamusume aspire toward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to achieve that, she firmly announces that she will be running in the Tiara tour: the Oka Sho, the Japanese Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.
